errors.evidence: The description states there are four categories, but the legend clearly shows five categories. It completely omits the 'Под 1 година' (Under 1 year) category, which has 0% of responses and is therefore not represented by a slice in the pie chart.

errors.text_span: като всеки етикет и съответният му процент са посочени в легендата вдясно
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the percentages for each category are listed in the legend. The legend contains only the category labels and their corresponding color codes; the percentage values are shown within the slices of the pie chart itself.

errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени по часовниковата стрелка, започвайки от горния десен ъгъл... Първият сектор, оцветен в тъмно лилаво... Вторият сектор, оцветен в оранжево... Третият сектор, в тъмно червено... Четвъртият сектор, в зелено...
errors.evidence: The description claims it will list the sectors in clockwise order, but the order in which they are presented (purple, orange, red, green) does not match the actual clockwise arrangement on the chart (purple, green, orange, red). This makes the description confusing to follow.
